notes.title: TWHG - Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Small update to fix issues with framepacing, consistency and level balancing. [/b]

- A 120 FPS limit is now set. This wields better consistency overall and avoid issues with obstacles movement, as issues could occur at higher refresh rates.

- Level 28 is now more balanced!

notes.title: The World's Hardest Game is now available!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560490/The_Worlds_Hardest_Game__On_Steam/

It features hardcore difficulty levels, with time and death counter (highscore saving). Level completion related achievements, 2 challenge achievements, and some beautiful achievements for your profile. Are you ready to face this challenge?
